jobs.description:
1 Senior Product Line Manager - OAM & Network Operations (m/w/d) Your tasks
 * Define and execute the OAM portfolio strategy and roadmap, aligned with business objectives, customer operational needs, market and technology trends, regulatory requirements, FRMCS evolution, and the GSM-R-to-FRMCS transition.
 * Manage the OAM portfolio across in-house 
 * Capture and translate customer, operational, market, standardization and regulatory requirements into product requirements and priorities and roadmap decisions.
 * Define and evolve OAM capabilities across network and service management, assurance, observability, fault, performance, configuration, inventory, software management and security, driving end-to-end visibility, service health, analytics and root-cause analysis across heterogeneous and multi-vendor environments.
 * Drive automation and intelligent operations across the OAM portfolio, leveraging advanced analytics and AI where relevant to simplify operational processes, diagnostics, troubleshooting and decision support.
 * Drive a consistent and intuitive OAM user experience, ensuring effective visualization of operational information and workflows.
 * Ensure interoperability and integration with customer OSS/NMS/IT environments and multi-vendor ecosystems through appropriate interfaces, APIs and data integration.
 * Drive OAM capabilities supporting GSM-R/FRMCS coexistence and migration, ensuring converged operability across both technologies throughout the transition.
 * Work closely with R&D, system architects and engineering teams to align technical direction and ensure products are designed for operability, maintainability, automation, diagnosability, upgradeability and long-term support.
 * Develop the OAM portfolio value proposition, positioning and support go-to-market activities.
 * Support sales and customer-facing teams through technical workshops, product presentations, proof-of-concepts, and strategic bid activities.
 * Monitor portfolio budget execution, ensuring delivery remains aligned with approved business objectives, priorities and financial targets

Your qualification
 * Degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline Several years of experience in Product Management, System Engineering or Solution Architecture within mission-critical communications.
 * Strong technical understanding of Operations & Maintenance systems for telecommunications or mission-critical communication networks.
 * Solid understanding of network management systems, OSS architectures, service assurance, and operational workflows.
 * Eperience with modern observability platforms and technologies, including metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, dashboarding and operational analytics (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, or similar).
 * Experience defining operational KPIs, service health indicators and dashboards that enable proactive monitoring and service assurance.
 * Good knowledge of IP networking, virtualization, Linux, cloud-native architectures, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps practices.
 * Experience with railway communication systems, preferably GSM-R and/or FRMCS, or equivalent mission-critical communication environments.
 * Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, software lifecycle management, and secure operational practices.
 * Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate operational challenges into product capabilities that improve operability, troubleshooting, automation, and service quality.
 * Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, operations teams, senior management, and engineering organizations.
 * Fluent English, German and/or French a plus

In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomicprecision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries.  * Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners
 * Experience in semiconductor, process design, deposition, etch dielectrics or conductor, metal films, etc.
